author: Collin Times
title: Keith Self calls for Senate action on SAVE Act and criticizes Obamacare subsidies - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman who secured reelection in both 2022 and 2024 against Sandeep Srivastava, used his social media platform on December 1, 2025, to address several legislative and political issues.
In an early post, Self endorsed fellow lawmaker Rep. John Rose’s position on the SAVE Act, stating on December 1: “.@RepJohnRose is exactly right. The SAVE Act is common-sense: require proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. The House passed it. Now it’s time for the Senate to do its job. Let’s get it to President Trump’s desk ASAP.”
Later that day, Self criticized federal healthcare policy under the Biden administration with another statement posted at 19:48 UTC: “Biden’s COVID-era Obamacare subsidies are a total disaster:
Sky-high costs for taxpayers
Rife with waste, fraud, and abuse
Lines the pockets of greedy insurance giants
Props up subpar care
Who in their right mind would vote to extend this mess? Let them expire on”
In a third post at 22:55 UTC, Self shared content from conservative commentator Charlie Kirk’s book, writing: “An excerpt from the late Charlie Kirk’s book ‘How We Win: Finding The Will Individually And Collectively To Fight’ Read every word. This is the battle conservatives face, and mere participation or survival isn’t going to cut it—we either win or we lose everything.”
Self has maintained his seat in Congress through consecutive victories over Sandeep Srivastava—first in 2022 with a margin of approximately 60.5% to 36.9%, and again in 2024 by a similar margin of about 62.5% to 37.6%. These results reflect continued support for Self among voters during recent election cycles.
